root_decision: HOLD; repair the complete leaf contract before test execution
findings: Active runtime roots normally have NULL terminal fields; the original validator and fixture incorrectly required an integer terminal unknown count.
The root native-session comparison was tautological and distinct parent/child AgentRun identities were not explicitly validated.
Queries joined related rows by root ID without filtering the complete tenant scope before emitting the raw projection.
The child-ready mode accepted pending native registrations.
Negative tests did not cover actual NULL terminal shape, ingress/audit isolation, settlement state or CLI JSON boundaries.
confirmed_contracts: An ordinary root with no tool calls may have zero native AgentRun registrations.
Ingress row status is pending, settled or unknown. A known denied authorization is stored as settled with outcome denied.
browser_policy: Reuse the current verified tab. Before opening a new test window, inspect and close the obsolete test window, then verify it is closed. Preserve unrelated user tabs.
